steps.content:
December 1, N.F. 114
Live at Eastside Tonight

steps.speaker: Host B
steps.content: Ladies and gentlemen, after four long years of waiting, the stage is once again lit for the DisCity Election as we enter the official voting month!

steps.speaker: Host B
steps.content: The cabinet attack has ignited discussions across the town! With the mastermind still unidentified, theories are swirling in every direction. This real-life mystery has stirred up a buzz around voting, pushing election fever to unprecedented heights!

steps.speaker: Host B
steps.content: Have our citizens finally risen from their political slumber, prepared to cast their votes in the pursuit of justice?! Will they expel the wicked wrongdoer and elevate a soul of integrity to the council throne?!

steps.speaker: Host B
steps.content: What? Even some are voting for the murderer? Saying "Stupid Stewart had it all coming"? Oh, our poor dear Prime Minister, you've finally made it to do the city some good—with your death, though...

steps.speaker: Host B
steps.content: Now, this is our Acting Prime Minister! How about a quick sound bite for us?
The host makes a gesture, and the director cuts to the live feed on cue.

steps.speaker: Acting Prime Minister
steps.content: ...While exercising your invaluable right to vote, everyone must remain vigilant and safeguard yourselves. Should you observe any suspicious individuals, please reach out to the Joint Security Committee and—

steps.speaker: Host B
steps.content: Alright, thanks for that! If only your predecessor had kicked the bucket sooner, you might've had a shot at running for office. Too bad luck wasn't on your side—you'll be out of that seat in a month.

steps.speaker: Host B
steps.content: But hey! At least you'll earn the prestigious title of DisCity's shortest-serving Prime Minister! Do watch your back though; we wouldn't want you setting another record for the shortest-living one, now would we?

steps.speaker: Host B
steps.content: Moving onto our next story—Pine, the famous online political commentator and conspiracy expert, has gone missing! Last time we heard from her, she was busy criticizing the election superstar MK, aka Max King. Now, could this be a case of speaking truth to power gone wrong—
[Bureau]

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: As the FAC's hands are tied during the election period, much of the security work has been handed over to the Sheriffs and us at the MBCC.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: But our past efforts have primarily focused on fighting Mania and tracking down Sinners, so we lack experience in civic security, even with the FAC's secret help.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: On top of that, training can be time-consuming and it's hard to find good instructors. So, Chief...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't we already have a former FAC elite right here?
When you bring up the training request to S9, she hesitates at first, seemingly reluctant to leave Elvira's side.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't worry, Jelena will still be with her. I promised her I'd keep your young lady safe.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We need you. Think of it as another way to protect Elvira.
Eventually, she agrees to your proposal.
